verdict.rationale: The only programmatic surface in the evidence is the developer-facing Authy API/SDK for adding 2FA to third-party apps, and it is closed to new customers and slated for deprecation. Nothing shows the app's own UI functions are exposed via API: token management, backups, device management and export. Community reports describe export as possible only through hacky debug-mode workarounds, which points to the absence of API parity.
